name: electronics: an assembly of a board and two chips (built by a macro); the study lists them with a role each
electronics: roles — the board through its select (in-plane / through conductivity appear), the chips as 1 W and 0.5 W sources with θjc
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const E = () => m.electronics; const a = m.active(); const [pcb, c1, c2] = a.components; const sel = q(`[data-pm-select="el.role:${pcb.id}"]`); sel.value = 'board'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(300); const kIn = Boolean(q(`[data-pm-field="el.kIn:${pcb.id}"]`)); E().setRole(c1.id, { role: 'source', power: 0.5, thetaJC: 5 }); E().setRole(c2.id, { role: 'source', power: 1, thetaJC: 5, limit: 45 }); E().setStudy({ velocity: 0.5, resolution: 10, maxSteps: 2500 }); await sleep(300); const bodies = E().bodies(); return JSON.stringify({ kIn, roles: bodies.map((b) => b.role).join(','), board: Array.isArray(bodies[0].k) && bodies[0].k.filter((x) => x === 0.3).length === 1, power: bodies.reduce((s, b) => s + b.power, 0) }); })()

name: electronics: a fan needs an enclosure — the run refuses with a message instead of running
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const E = () => m.electronics; E().setStudy({ flow: 'fan' }); await sleep(200); const before = m.state.log?.length ?? 0; const r = await E().run(); await sleep(200); const last = (m.state.log ?? []).slice(0, 3).map((x) => x.text ?? '').join(' '); E().setStudy({ flow: 'forced' }); await sleep(200); return JSON.stringify({ refused: r === null, said: /외함|enclosure/i.test(last) }); })()

name: electronics: the run (worker) — the air takes the 1.5 W, the 1 W chip is hotter, T_j = case + θjc P; the components are coloured
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const E = () => m.electronics; q('[data-pm="el.run"]').click(); let r = null; for (let i = 0; i < 340 && !(r = m.state.editing?.result); i++) await sleep(500); await sleep(500); const comps = r.components; const u1 = comps[1], u2 = comps[2]; const coloured = [...m.viewport.bodies.keys()].filter((k) => k.startsWith('elres:')).length; const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.el-table tr').length; return JSON.stringify({ ran: Boolean(r), heat: Math.abs(r.heat - 1.5) < 0.15, heatW: Math.round(r.heat * 100) / 100, hotter: u2.max > u1.max, junction: Math.abs(u2.junction - (u2.max + 5)) < 1e-6, coloured, rows, legend: Boolean(q('.left-pm-body .sim-legend')) }); })()

name: electronics: the roles are kept in the assembly (undoable); closing the study restores the plain components
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const E = () => m.electronics; const kept = Object.values(m.active().electronics.roles).filter((r) => r.role === 'source').length; await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(300); const undoneFlow = m.active().electronics.flow; await m.actions.redo(); await sleep(300); await m.run('electronicsCooling'); await sleep(500); const coloured = [...m.viewport.bodies.keys()].filter((k) => k.startsWith('elres:')).length; return JSON.stringify({ kept, undone: undoneFlow === 'fan' && m.active().electronics.flow === 'forced', mode: m.state.editing?.mode ?? null, coloured }); })()
